service_scope: Explicit pediatric initiation; current heading>=2024-05-17; prior/missing dates manual review. Exact medicine required.

hints.gh_reported_growth_age_band: Explicit clinician-recorded source age band. Do not compute a band from numerical age or interpret source2,1/4,1 as decimal-years/months. Clear age/band contradictions yield reconciliation review; transition intervals2–2.1 and4–4.1 are deliberately not reclassified.
hints.gh_pubertal_growth_assessment_completed: Source-described pediatric endocrine/endocrine-metabolism specialist assessment of monitoring period and growth using other findings is documented.
hints.gh_pubertal_status: Clinician-recorded assessment using SUT §4.2.6.A-1(1)(b)(3): onset is testicular volume >=4 ml in boys or T2 thelarche in girls. Enter prepubertal/pubertal only when the recorded assessment uses that definition; otherwise leave unknown. Do not infer from age, diagnosis or height-reference sex; no raw measurements are requested.
hints.gh_sga_birth_status_confirmed: Recorded small-for-gestational-age birth confirmation for sourcecase2; not derived from diagnosis.

puberty_assessment_contract.rationale: The existing nullable enum is itself the documented source-defined clinician assessment. A second boolean would duplicate that fact without verifying it. Older generic assessments must be reconciled by the clinician or left unknown; this clarification does not retrospectively validate them. The application neither collects raw measurements nor diagnoses puberty.
